```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
```

```{r colors}
source("R/Set_colors.R")
```

The SHCS CHIP trajectories are built from the Mutect2 calls of the longitudinal sequencing
(`resources/chip_calls.csv`), with the calls of the earlier cross-sectional CHIP screening if `use_cross` is
`TRUE` (Parameters). Every measurement gets
a limit of detection (LoD) from the `chip_lod` package, the trajectories are filtered on VAF and LoD, extended
with timepoints from the bam-readcount pileup, and the timepoints at which a variant is not detected get a VAF of
half the LoD of the timepoint.

| Section | Step |
|---|---|
| 1 | Data; removal of the individuals without a CHIP call and of the samples with DNA from another person |
| 2 | LoD of all Mutect2 CHIP calls |
| 3 | Unfiltered trajectories |
| 4 | Calls of the cross-sectional CHIP screening (added to the trajectories only with `use_cross`) |
| 5 | Filter: >= 1 timepoint with VAF >= 2% and >= `min_tp_above_lod` timepoints with VAF >= LoD |
| 6 | Timepoints added from bam-readcount |
| 7 | Filter: >= 2 detected timepoints, >= 1 of them with VAF >= 2% |
| 8 | LoD per trajectory; VAF of the not detected timepoints |
| 9 | Counts after each step |
| 10 | Final table |
| 11 | Plots and tables |

Terms used throughout:

- **call**: one record of a CHIP variant in one sample, from Mutect2 (longitudinal sequencing) or from the
  cross-sectional screening.
- **trajectory**: one variant in one individual (`traj_id` = `ID:Variant`).
- **timepoint**: one sequenced sample of an individual. Every longitudinal sample of an individual is a timepoint
  of each of its trajectories; with `use_cross`, the cross-sectional sample is a timepoint of the trajectories
  called in it.
- **detected / not detected**: the variant has a measured VAF at this timepoint (a call, or bam-readcount from
  section 6 on) / the longitudinal sample was sequenced but the variant has no measured VAF.

The notebook writes the final table and the two intermediate tables to `resources/` (section 10), and the
figures and tables of section 11 to `figures/`, `results/` and `output/` (`paper_dir`:
`Figure1/`, `Tables/`, `Supplementary_Figures/`).


# Parameters

```{r parameters}
chip_vaf     <- 0.02              # CHIP VAF threshold
excluded_ids <- scan("resources/excluded_individuals.txt", quiet = TRUE)   # individuals with inconsistent CHIP data (no CHIP call), removed

# chip_lod (package defaults, as in 01_per_sample_LoD_and_QC.Rmd)
err_rate  <- 0.001                # per-base sequencing error rate e
alpha     <- 0.05                 # per-site false-positive rate used for k*
power_tgt <- 0.95                 # detection probability that defines the LoD

use_cross        <- FALSE         # section 4: TRUE adds the calls of the cross-sectional screening to the trajectories
min_tp_above_lod <- 1             # section 5: calls with VAF >= LoD a trajectory needs (1 or 2)
min_alt_reads    <- 1             # section 6: reads of the variant allele that make a bam-readcount timepoint
min_timepoints   <- 2             # section 7: detected timepoints a trajectory needs
impute_fraction  <- 0.5           # section 8: VAF of a not detected timepoint = impute_fraction x LoD of the timepoint

# One sample is in the pileup twice, under two suffixed names (01_per_sample_LoD_and_QC.Rmd, section 3.1: the two
# runs hold the same reads). resources/pileup_sample_names.txt lists the run to use and the run to drop
# (tab-separated: pileup_name, action = use / drop, sample)
pileup_names <- read.delim("resources/pileup_sample_names.txt", colClasses = "character")
pileup_sample_alias <- with(subset(pileup_names, action == "use"), setNames(sample, pileup_name))
pileup_sample_drop  <- subset(pileup_names, action == "drop")$pileup_name

paper_dir <- "output"   # sections 11.4-11.6 write here (Tables/, Supplementary_Figures/)
                                                    # the plots of sections 11.1-11.3 use the same folder (Figure1/)
for (d in c("results", "figures", file.path(paper_dir, c("Figure1", "Tables", "Supplementary_Figures")))) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

stopifnot(is.logical(use_cross), min_tp_above_lod %in% 1:2, min_alt_reads >= 1, impute_fraction > 0)

status_levels <- c("VAF >= LoD", "called, VAF < LoD", "not called (k < k*)")
status_colors <- setNames(c("#2a78d6", "#E69F00", "#898781"), status_levels)
shape_status  <- c("Mutect2, VAF >= LoD" = 16, "Mutect2, VAF < LoD" = 17, "not detected" = 4)
shape_cross   <- c("Mutect2" = 16, "cross-sectional" = 15, "not detected" = 4)
shape_source  <- c("Mutect2" = 16, "cross-sectional" = 15, "bam-readcount" = 17, "not detected" = 4)
shape_imputed <- c("Mutect2" = 16, "cross-sectional" = 15, "bam-readcount" = 17, "imputed" = 1)

# without the cross-sectional calls their shape is left out of the legends
if (!use_cross) {
  shape_cross   <- shape_cross[names(shape_cross) != "cross-sectional"]
  shape_source  <- shape_source[names(shape_source) != "cross-sectional"]
  shape_imputed <- shape_imputed[names(shape_imputed) != "cross-sectional"]
}

med_iqr <- function(x, digits = 0, scale = 1) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return("-")
  q <- quantile(x * scale, c(0.5, 0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
  sprintf("%.*f (%.*f-%.*f)", digits, q[1], digits, q[2], digits, q[3])
}
n_pct <- function(x) sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(x), 100 * mean(x))
```

Two helpers are used in every section: `record_step()` reports the counts left after a step (and keeps them for
section 9), `plot_traj()` draws one panel per individual.

```{r helpers}
step_counts <- tibble()

# obs: one row per trajectory and timepoint, `detected` marks a measured VAF
record_step <- function(step, obs) {
  row <- obs %>%
    summarise(individuals = n_distinct(ID),
              `samples (timepoints)` = n_distinct(Sample),
              `samples with a detected variant` = n_distinct(Sample[detected]),
              trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id),
              `detected timepoints` = sum(detected),
              `not detected timepoints` = sum(!detected)) %>%
    mutate(step = step, .before = 1)
  step_counts <<- bind_rows(step_counts, row)
  knitr::kable(row)
}

# y = AF_plot; not detected timepoints are drawn at 0 on the linear scale
plot_traj <- function(df, shape_by, shapes, title = NULL, y_log = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Age, y = AF_plot, color = Gene.refGene, group = traj_id)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = .data[[shape_by]]), size = 1.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shapes, limits = names(shapes)) +
    facet_wrap(~ID, nrow = 7, ncol = 9) +
    labs(y = "VAF", color = "CHIP gene", shape = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_classic()
  if (y_log) p <- p + scale_y_log10(labels = percent)
  p
}
```


# 1. Data

## 1.1 Sequenced samples

A longitudinal sample was sequenced if it has a Mutect2 VCF (`resources/mutect2_Calls/mutect2_output`). Removed:

- individuals with a single sample (not part of the longitudinal study);
- the individuals who have no CHIP call (`resources/excluded_individuals.txt`);
- the samples with DNA from another person (`mixed == TRUE` in `resources/SHCS_sample_contamination_QC.txt`,
  written by `01_per_sample_LoD_and_QC.Rmd`, section 3.3). In such a sample the real clones are diluted and
  the other person's variants look like low-VAF calls, so neither its calls nor its "not detected" timepoints
  are used.

```{r samples}
vcf_samples <- sub(".vcf.gz$", "", list.files("resources/mutect2_Calls/mutect2_output", pattern = "vcf.gz$"))

sample_qc     <- read.table("resources/SHCS_sample_contamination_QC.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
mixed_samples <- sample_qc$S_ID[sample_qc$mixed]

samples_all <- read.csv("resources/samples_with_dates.csv") %>%
  transmute(Sample  = ID,
            ID      = as.numeric(gsub("ID SHCS ", "", Subject.Id)),
            LABDATE = as.Date(gsub(" 00:00:00", "", Collection), format = "%d/%m/%Y")) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(longitudinal = n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sequenced   = Sample %in% vcf_samples,
         excluded_id = ID %in% excluded_ids,
         mixed       = Sample %in% mixed_samples)
stopifnot(all(vcf_samples %in% samples_all$Sample))

samples_all %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(!longitudinal ~ "removed: individual with a single sample",
                           excluded_id   ~ "removed: individual without a CHIP call",
                           !sequenced    ~ "no Mutect2 VCF",
                           mixed         ~ "removed: DNA from another person",
                           TRUE          ~ "kept")) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(samples = n(), `with a Mutect2 VCF` = sum(sequenced), individuals = n_distinct(ID)) %>%
  knitr::kable()

sample_qc %>%
  filter(mixed) %>%
  select(ID, S_ID, LABDATE, hom_sites, foreign_read_share, mixed_sample_min) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Samples with DNA from another person")
```

Demographics from the SHCS database (December 2024). Age at a timepoint is the collection year minus the birth
year.

```{r seq-samples}
pat <- read.csv("resources/SHCS_database/2024-12/pat.csv") %>%
  select(ID, BORN, SEX, GENETIC_SEX, ETHNICITY, HIV_POSDATE, IVD, RISK, CV_SMOKED)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pat$ID))

seq_samples <- samples_all %>%
  filter(longitudinal, sequenced, !excluded_id, !mixed) %>%
  select(ID, Sample, LABDATE) %>%
  left_join(pat %>% select(ID, BORN), by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(LABYEAR = year(LABDATE), Age = LABYEAR - BORN)
stopifnot(!anyNA(seq_samples$Age))

c(samples = nrow(seq_samples), individuals = n_distinct(seq_samples$ID))
```


## 1.2 Mutect2 CHIP calls

`resources/chip_calls.csv` (written by `scripts/merge_mutect2_output.R`) has the Mutect2 records at CHIP
positions, in VCF coordinates. The transcript of interest (`Variant`) is the entry of `AAChange.refGene`
(`GeneDetail.refGene` for splicing variants) on the accession listed in `CHIP_candidate_variants.csv`.
`add_variant()` is used for the calls of both assays.

```{r annotation-helpers}
chip_crit <- read.csv("resources/CHIP_screening/CHIP_candidate_variants.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
accession_pattern <- paste(chip_crit$Accession, collapse = "|")

# the one entry of a "sep"-separated annotation on an accession of interest
pick_transcript <- function(x, sep) {
  hits <- grep(accession_pattern, strsplit(x, sep, fixed = TRUE)[[1]], value = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(hits) == 1)
  hits
}

# transcript of interest from AAChange.refGene, or GeneDetail.refGene for splicing variants (NA stays NA)
transcript_of <- function(aachange, genedetail) {
  x <- ifelse(aachange == ".", genedetail, aachange)
  map_chr(x, function(a) if (is.na(a)) NA_character_ else pick_transcript(pick_transcript(a, ","), ";"))
}

add_variant <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Variant            = transcript_of(AAChange.refGene, GeneDetail.refGene),
           ExonicFunc.refGene = ifelse(ExonicFunc.refGene == ".", Func.refGene, ExonicFunc.refGene),
           AAChange.refGene   = ifelse(AAChange.refGene == ".", GeneDetail.refGene, AAChange.refGene),
           traj_id            = paste(ID, Variant, sep = ":"))
}
```

`get_variant_locus()` (from `01_per_sample_LoD_and_QC.Rmd`) converts the VCF position and alleles to the
ANNOVAR convention and to the allele string of the bam-readcount pileup (`A`, `+A`, `-A`). `rc_pos` is both the
ANNOVAR `Start` and the position of the variant in the pileup.

```{r variant-locus}
# VCF (POS, REF, ALT) -> locus and alleles as used by ANNOVAR and bam-readcount.
#   rc_pos                   : ANNOVAR Start, position of the variant in the bam-readcount output
#   annovar_ref, annovar_alt : alleles in ANNOVAR coordinates ("-" for the missing allele of an indel)
#   rc_allele                : allele string in the bam-readcount output ("A", "+A", "-A")
get_variant_locus <- function(pos, ref, alt) {
  ref <- toupper(ref)
  alt <- toupper(alt)

  if (nchar(ref) == nchar(alt)) {
    return(tibble(var_type = ifelse(nchar(ref) == 1, "SNV", "MNV"), rc_pos = pos,
                  annovar_ref = ref, annovar_alt = alt, rc_allele = alt))
  }

  # strip shared leading bases beyond the single VCF anchor base
  while (nchar(ref) > 1 && nchar(alt) > 1 && substr(ref, 1, 1) == substr(alt, 1, 1)) {
    ref <- substr(ref, 2, nchar(ref))
    alt <- substr(alt, 2, nchar(alt))
    pos <- pos + 1
  }

  if (nchar(alt) > nchar(ref)) {
    # insertion: stays at the anchor position
    inserted <- substr(alt, 2, nchar(alt))
    tibble(var_type = "insertion", rc_pos = pos, annovar_ref = "-", annovar_alt = inserted,
           rc_allele = paste0("+", inserted))
  } else {
    # deletion: starts one base after the anchor
    deleted <- substr(ref, 2, nchar(ref))
    tibble(var_type = "deletion", rc_pos = pos + 1, annovar_ref = deleted, annovar_alt = "-",
           rc_allele = paste0("-", deleted))
  }
}
```

**Annotation of the called allele.** `merge_mutect2_output.R` gives each Mutect2 record the annotation of a CHIP
variant of the Vanderbilt list found at the same position (+/- 1 bp), without comparing the alleles. A record
next to a listed variant can therefore carry the annotation of another variant, and a record with two listed
variants within 1 bp is written twice, once with each annotation. Here each record keeps one row with the
annotation of its own allele, looked up by position and alleles (ANNOVAR coordinates) in the two lists of
annotated CHIP variants: the Vanderbilt list (used only for its annotation, not as calls) and the cross-sectional
screening. A record whose allele is in neither list is removed: it is not a known CHIP variant.

```{r annotation-check}
dict_cols <- c("Gene.refGene", "End", "Func.refGene", "GeneDetail.refGene", "ExonicFunc.refGene",
               "AAChange.refGene", "cosmic70")

cross_all <- read.table("resources/CHIP_screening/SHCS_Chip_all_vars.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

annot_dict <- bind_rows(
  read.csv("resources/CHIP_calls_longitudinal/CHIP_calls_all_long.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM") %>%
    select(Chr, Start, Ref, Alt, all_of(dict_cols)),
  cross_all %>% select(Chr, Start, Ref, Alt, all_of(dict_cols))) %>%
  distinct()
# one annotation per variant: the two lists agree wherever both list a variant
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(annot_dict[c("Chr", "Start", "Ref", "Alt")]))

chip_calls_file <- read.csv("resources/chip_calls.csv")

# no multiallelic records in this file
stopifnot(!any(grepl(",", chip_calls_file$V5)))

annot_check <- chip_calls_file %>%
  rename(Chr = V1, Start = V2, Ref = V4, Alt = V5, FILTER = V7) %>%
  mutate(locus = pmap(list(Start, Ref, Alt), get_variant_locus)) %>%
  unnest(locus) %>%
  left_join(annot_dict %>% rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_allele"), all_of(dict_cols)),
            by = c("Chr", "rc_pos" = "Start", "annovar_ref" = "Ref", "annovar_alt" = "Alt")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Chr, Start, Ref, Alt) %>%
  mutate(own = !is.na(AAChange.refGene_allele) & AAChange.refGene == AAChange.refGene_allele &
               GeneDetail.refGene == GeneDetail.refGene_allele,
         row = case_when(is.na(AAChange.refGene_allele) ~ "allele in neither list: removed",
                         own                            ~ "annotation of the called allele",
                         any(own)                       ~ "second row of the record, annotation of a neighbouring variant: removed",
                         TRUE                           ~ "annotation of a neighbouring variant: replaced")) %>%
  ungroup()

annot_check %>%
  group_by(row) %>%
  summarise(rows = n(), records = nrow(distinct(pick(Sample, Chr, Start, Ref, Alt))),
            variants = nrow(distinct(pick(Chr, Start, Ref, Alt)))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Rows of chip_calls.csv")

annot_check %>%
  filter(row != "annotation of the called allele") %>%
  arrange(row, Chr, Start, Sample) %>%
  transmute(Sample, Chr, Start, Ref, Alt, AF, row,
            `annotation in chip_calls.csv` = transcript_of(AAChange.refGene, GeneDetail.refGene),
            `annotation of the called allele` = transcript_of(AAChange.refGene_allele, GeneDetail.refGene_allele)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r calls}
calls_raw <- annot_check %>%
  filter(row %in% c("annotation of the called allele", "annotation of a neighbouring variant: replaced")) %>%
  distinct(Sample, Chr, Start, Ref, Alt, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-all_of(dict_cols), -own, -row, -Accession, -transcriptOI, -NonsynOI) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("_allele$", "", .x), all_of(paste0(dict_cols, "_allele"))) %>%
  inner_join(samples_all %>% select(Sample, ID, LABDATE, longitudinal, excluded_id, mixed), by = "Sample") %>%
  add_variant() %>%
  separate(AD, into = c("ref_reads", "alt_reads"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE, remove = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(calls_raw) == sum(annot_check$row %in% c("annotation of the called allele",
                                                         "annotation of a neighbouring variant: replaced")),
          all(calls_raw$ref_reads + calls_raw$alt_reads == calls_raw$DP),
          # one genomic variant per trajectory, at most one call per trajectory and sample
          !anyDuplicated(distinct(calls_raw, traj_id, Chr, Start, Ref, Alt)$traj_id),
          !anyDuplicated(calls_raw[c("traj_id", "Sample")]))

calls_raw %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(!longitudinal ~ "removed: individual with a single sample",
                           excluded_id   ~ "removed: individual without a CHIP call",
                           mixed         ~ "removed: sample with DNA from another person",
                           TRUE          ~ "kept")) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(calls = n(), samples = n_distinct(Sample), individuals = n_distinct(ID),
            trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Mutect2 CHIP calls")
```

Counts before the removal (all sequenced samples):

```{r counts-raw}
obs_raw <- calls_raw %>%
  distinct(ID, traj_id) %>%
  inner_join(samples_all %>% filter(sequenced) %>% select(ID, Sample), by = "ID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  left_join(calls_raw %>% distinct(traj_id, Sample) %>% mutate(detected = TRUE), by = c("traj_id", "Sample")) %>%
  mutate(detected = replace_na(detected, FALSE))

record_step("0. Mutect2 CHIP calls, all sequenced samples", obs_raw)
```

The calls kept, with the age at the timepoint. Mutect2 filter flags are not used:

```{r calls-kept}
calls <- calls_raw %>%
  filter(longitudinal, !excluded_id, !mixed) %>%
  select(-longitudinal, -excluded_id, -mixed, -LABDATE) %>%
  inner_join(seq_samples, by = c("ID", "Sample"))
stopifnot(nrow(calls) == sum(calls_raw$longitudinal & !calls_raw$excluded_id & !calls_raw$mixed))

table(FILTER = calls$FILTER)
```

One annotation per trajectory, with the locus and allele of the pileup:

```{r traj-annot}
annot_cols <- c("Gene.refGene", "Chr", "Start", "End", "Ref", "Alt", "Func.refGene", "GeneDetail.refGene",
                "ExonicFunc.refGene", "AAChange.refGene", "cosmic70", "Variant")

traj_annot_long <- calls %>%
  arrange(traj_id, LABDATE) %>%
  group_by(traj_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ID, traj_id, all_of(annot_cols), var_type, rc_pos, rc_allele)

table(variant_type = traj_annot_long$var_type)
```


## 1.3 bam-readcount pileup

`resources/All.chip.bam_readcount.txt` has the read counts of every base at the CHIP positions in every
longitudinal sample, with the alleles packed into `var1..varN` as `allele:count:avg_mapq:avg_baseq`. Overlapping
regions list some positions twice; these rows are exact duplicates and are removed.

```{r pileup}
pileup <- read.table("resources/All.chip.bam_readcount.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(ref = "character")) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(S_ID != pileup_sample_drop) %>%
  mutate(S_ID = coalesce(unname(pileup_sample_alias[S_ID]), S_ID))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pileup[c("S_ID", "chr", "pos")]),
          all(seq_samples$Sample %in% pileup$S_ID))

pileup_sites <- pileup %>% select(S_ID, chr, pos, pileup_depth = depth)

# one row per allele seen at each sample and position
pileup_alleles <- pileup %>%
  select(S_ID, chr, pos, starts_with("var")) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("var"), names_to = NULL, values_to = "allele_str", values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
  filter(allele_str != "") %>%
  separate(allele_str, into = c("allele", "pileup_alt"), sep = ":", extra = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pileup_alt = as.integer(pileup_alt))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pileup_alleles[c("S_ID", "chr", "pos", "allele")]))
```

The pileup counts are not filtered on base quality, Mutect2's are. Check of the locus mapping on the Mutect2
calls: the pileup should see the called allele with about as many reads as Mutect2.

```{r pileup-check}
calls %>%
  left_join(pileup_sites, by = c("Sample" = "S_ID", "Chr" = "chr", "rc_pos" = "pos")) %>%
  left_join(pileup_alleles, by = c("Sample" = "S_ID", "Chr" = "chr", "rc_pos" = "pos", "rc_allele" = "allele")) %>%
  group_by(var_type) %>%
  summarise(calls = n(),
            `with pileup depth` = sum(!is.na(pileup_depth)),
            `allele seen in the pileup` = sum(!is.na(pileup_alt)),
            `pileup / Mutect2 alt reads, median` = round(median(pileup_alt / alt_reads, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            `pileup depth / Mutect2 DP, median` = round(median(pileup_depth / DP, na.rm = TRUE), 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```


# 2. LoD of the Mutect2 CHIP calls

For a site with depth `n` and `k` reads of the variant allele, `lod_frequentist()` of
[`chip_lod`](https://github.com/adriaan-vd-graaf/chip_lod) (in `external/chip_lod`) returns:

| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| `k_star` | smallest read count with P(K >= k) <= `alpha` under sequencing error alone (Poisson, `n * e / 3`) |
| `called` | `k >= k_star` |
| `lod_vaf` | smallest true VAF that reaches `k_star` reads with probability >= `power_target` at this depth |

`k_star` and `lod_vaf` depend only on depth. As in `01_per_sample_LoD_and_QC.Rmd`, only `model.R` and `lod.R` are sourced,
into their own environment. `add_lod()` runs the package on the (`n`, `k`) pairs not seen before and keeps the
results in `lod_tab`, so each pair is calculated once.

```{r chip-lod}
chip_lod <- new.env()
for (f in c("model.R", "lod.R")) {
  sys.source(file.path("external/chip_lod", "r", "R", f), envir = chip_lod)
}
lod_frequentist <- chip_lod$lod_frequentist

lod_tab <- NULL

# df with read counts n (depth) and k (variant reads), NA where there is no depth
add_lod <- function(df) {
  new_pairs <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(n), n > 0) %>%
    distinct(n, k) %>%
    mutate(n = as.integer(n), k = as.integer(k))
  if (!is.null(lod_tab)) new_pairs <- anti_join(new_pairs, lod_tab, by = c("n", "k"))
  if (nrow(new_pairs) > 0) {
    lod_tab <<- bind_rows(lod_tab,
                          lod_frequentist(n = new_pairs$n, k = new_pairs$k,
                                          e = err_rate, alpha = alpha, power_target = power_tgt) %>%
                            select(n, k, k_star, called, lod_vaf))
  }
  df %>%
    left_join(lod_tab, by = c("n", "k")) %>%
    mutate(vaf_reads  = k / n,
           lod_status = case_when(is.na(lod_vaf)        ~ NA_character_,
                                  !called               ~ "not called (k < k*)",
                                  vaf_reads < lod_vaf   ~ "called, VAF < LoD",
                                  TRUE                  ~ "VAF >= LoD"),
           lod_status = factor(lod_status, levels = status_levels))
}
```

LoD of every Mutect2 call kept in section 1, from Mutect2's own read counts (`n = DP`, `k` = alternate reads of
`AD`). The LoD is compared with the read fraction `k / n`, which is on the scale of `lod_vaf`; the CHIP threshold
of 2% is applied to Mutect2's `AF`, the VAF of the final table. The two differ a little:

```{r calls-lod}
calls <- calls %>%
  mutate(n = DP, k = alt_reads) %>%
  add_lod()
stopifnot(!anyNA(calls$lod_vaf))

table(`Mutect2 AF >= 2%` = calls$AF >= chip_vaf, `k / n >= 2%` = calls$vaf_reads >= chip_vaf)
```

**Summary of all Mutect2 CHIP calls** (after the removal of section 1):

```{r calls-lod-summary}
calls %>%
  summarise(calls = n(), samples = n_distinct(Sample), individuals = n_distinct(ID),
            `variants x individuals` = n_distinct(traj_id),
            `calls with VAF >= LoD` = n_pct(lod_status == "VAF >= LoD"),
            `calls with VAF >= 2%` = n_pct(AF >= chip_vaf),
            `calls with VAF >= LoD and >= 2%` = n_pct(lod_status == "VAF >= LoD" & AF >= chip_vaf)) %>%
  knitr::kable()

calls %>%
  summarise(`depth (DP), median (IQR)` = med_iqr(n),
            `depth, range` = paste(range(n), collapse = "-"),
            `k*, range` = paste(range(k_star), collapse = "-"),
            `LoD VAF %, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(lod_vaf, 2, 100),
            `LoD VAF %, range` = paste(round(100 * range(lod_vaf), 2), collapse = "-"),
            `VAF % (AF), median (IQR)` = med_iqr(AF, 2, 100)) %>%
  knitr::kable()

calls %>%
  count(lod_status, `VAF >= 2%` = ifelse(AF >= chip_vaf, "VAF >= 2%", "VAF < 2%")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = `VAF >= 2%`, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Calls by LoD status and VAF")
```

By gene:

```{r calls-lod-gene}
calls %>%
  group_by(Gene.refGene) %>%
  summarise(calls = n(), trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id),
            `VAF >= LoD` = n_pct(lod_status == "VAF >= LoD"),
            `VAF >= 2%` = n_pct(AF >= chip_vaf),
            `LoD VAF %, median` = round(100 * median(lod_vaf), 2)) %>%
  arrange(-calls) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

Each point is one call; line: LoD at each depth, dashed line: 2%.

```{r calls-lod-plot, fig.height=4.5}
ggplot(calls, aes(x = n, y = vaf_reads)) +
  geom_line(data = calls %>% distinct(n, lod_vaf), aes(y = lod_vaf), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = lod_status), size = 1.3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = percent) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Depth (Mutect2 DP)", y = "VAF (k / n)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
```

`r sum(calls$lod_status != "VAF >= LoD")` of the `r nrow(calls)` calls are below the LoD (listed if any):

```{r calls-below-lod}
if (any(calls$lod_status != "VAF >= LoD")) calls %>%
  filter(lod_status != "VAF >= LoD") %>%
  arrange(ID, Variant, LABDATE) %>%
  transmute(ID, Sample, Gene.refGene, Variant, FILTER, n, k, k_star, `VAF % (k/n)` = round(100 * vaf_reads, 3),
            `LoD VAF %` = round(100 * lod_vaf, 3), lod_status) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```


# 3. Unfiltered trajectories

Every trajectory is crossed with all longitudinal samples of its individual. At a timepoint with a Mutect2 call
the read counts are Mutect2's; at the other timepoints they are the pileup counts at the variant (`k = 0` where
the allele was not seen), which give the LoD of the timepoint and are used in sections 6 and 8.

```{r grid}
call_cols <- c("traj_id", "Sample", "AF", "DP", "GT", "AD", "F1R2", "F2R1", "FILTER", "alt_reads")

# every trajectory x every longitudinal sample of its individual
build_grid <- function(traj) {
  traj %>%
    inner_join(seq_samples, by = "ID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    left_join(calls %>% select(all_of(call_cols)) %>% mutate(mutect = TRUE), by = c("traj_id", "Sample")) %>%
    left_join(pileup_sites, by = c("Sample" = "S_ID", "Chr" = "chr", "rc_pos" = "pos")) %>%
    left_join(pileup_alleles, by = c("Sample" = "S_ID", "Chr" = "chr", "rc_pos" = "pos", "rc_allele" = "allele")) %>%
    mutate(mutect     = replace_na(mutect, FALSE),
           pileup_alt = ifelse(is.na(pileup_depth), NA, replace_na(pileup_alt, 0L)),
           # read counts for the LoD: Mutect2's at a call, the pileup's at the other timepoints
           n = ifelse(mutect, DP, pileup_depth),
           k = ifelse(mutect, alt_reads, pileup_alt),
           type     = "long",
           source   = ifelse(mutect, "Mutect2", "not detected"),
           detected = mutect) %>%
    add_lod()
}

grid_long <- build_grid(traj_annot_long) %>%
  arrange(ID, traj_id, LABDATE)
stopifnot(sum(grid_long$mutect) == nrow(calls), !anyDuplicated(grid_long[c("traj_id", "Sample")]))

grid_long %>%
  group_by(`Mutect2 call` = mutect) %>%
  summarise(timepoints = n(), `with depth` = sum(!is.na(n)), `LoD available` = sum(!is.na(lod_vaf))) %>%
  knitr::kable()

record_step("1-3. Mutect2 CHIP calls after removal of 2 individuals and mixed samples", grid_long)
```

All trajectories, one panel per individual. Filled circle: Mutect2 call with VAF >= LoD; triangle: Mutect2 call
below the LoD; cross: sequenced sample without a call of this variant (drawn at 0). Dashed line: 2%.

```{r plot-unfiltered, fig.width=14, fig.height=11}
grid_long %>%
  mutate(point   = case_when(mutect & lod_status == "VAF >= LoD" ~ "Mutect2, VAF >= LoD",
                             mutect                              ~ "Mutect2, VAF < LoD",
                             TRUE                                ~ "not detected"),
         AF_plot = ifelse(mutect, AF, 0)) %>%
  plot_traj("point", shape_status, "Mutect2 CHIP calls, unfiltered")
```


# 4. Cross-sectional CHIP screening

The calls of the cross-sectional CHIP screening (`SHCS_Chip_all_vars.txt`, one sample per individual, date in
`SHCS_Chip_per_person.txt`) are read for the individuals of section 1. They are added to the trajectories only if
`use_cross` is `TRUE` (now `r use_cross`); otherwise they are only summarised here, and the rest of the notebook
uses the longitudinal sequencing alone. The screening used another DNA sample, so the removal of samples with DNA
from another person does not apply to it. Its coordinates are ANNOVAR's, which already give the locus and allele
of the pileup (`-` marks the missing allele of an indel).

```{r cross}
# cross_all: all calls of the screening, read in section 1.2
cross_per_person <- read.table("resources/CHIP_screening/SHCS_Chip_per_person.txt", sep = " ", header = TRUE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(cross_per_person$ID))

cross_calls <- cross_all %>%
  filter(ID %in% seq_samples$ID) %>%
  select(ID, all_of(setdiff(annot_cols, "Variant")), GT, AD, AF, DP, F1R2, F2R1) %>%
  inner_join(cross_per_person %>% transmute(ID, Sample, LABDATE = as.Date(LABDATE)), by = "ID") %>%
  left_join(pat %>% select(ID, BORN), by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(LABYEAR = year(LABDATE), Age = LABYEAR - BORN) %>%
  add_variant() %>%
  separate(AD, into = c("ref_reads", "alt_reads"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE, remove = FALSE) %>%
  # ANNOVAR (Start, Ref, Alt) -> locus and allele of the pileup
  mutate(var_type  = case_when(Ref == "-"                        ~ "insertion",
                               Alt == "-"                        ~ "deletion",
                               nchar(Ref) == 1 & nchar(Alt) == 1 ~ "SNV",
                               TRUE                              ~ "MNV"),
         rc_pos    = Start,
         rc_allele = case_when(Ref == "-" ~ paste0("+", Alt),
                               Alt == "-" ~ paste0("-", Ref),
                               TRUE       ~ Alt),
         n = DP, k = alt_reads) %>%
  add_lod()
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(cross_calls$traj_id), !anyNA(cross_calls$Age), all(cross_calls$k <= cross_calls$n),
          !any(cross_calls$Sample %in% seq_samples$Sample))

# a variant called in both assays has the same traj_id and the same pileup locus, and no cross-sectional call
# sits at the locus of a Mutect2 trajectory under another traj_id
in_both <- cross_calls %>%
  select(traj_id, rc_pos, rc_allele) %>%
  inner_join(traj_annot_long %>% select(traj_id, rc_pos_long = rc_pos, rc_allele_long = rc_allele), by = "traj_id")
stopifnot(all(in_both$rc_pos == in_both$rc_pos_long & in_both$rc_allele == in_both$rc_allele_long),
          nrow(cross_calls %>%
                 anti_join(traj_annot_long, by = "traj_id") %>%
                 semi_join(traj_annot_long, by = c("ID", "Chr", "rc_pos", "rc_allele"))) == 0)

cross_calls %>%
  summarise(calls = n(), individuals = n_distinct(ID),
            `variant also called by Mutect2` = sum(traj_id %in% traj_annot_long$traj_id),
            `variant only in the screening` = sum(!traj_id %in% traj_annot_long$traj_id),
            `sample date = a longitudinal sample date` = sum(paste(ID, LABDATE) %in% paste(seq_samples$ID, seq_samples$LABDATE)),
            `depth, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(n),
            `VAF %, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(AF, 2, 100),
            `LoD VAF %, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(lod_vaf, 2, 100),
            `VAF >= LoD` = n_pct(lod_status == "VAF >= LoD")) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Cross-sectional calls")
```

The screening reports calls with VAF >= 2% only (the smallest VAF of all its calls is
`r percent(min(cross_all$AF), 0.1)`), and its reads are not available here. When used, a cross-sectional call is
therefore a detected timepoint, but a variant without a cross-sectional call gets no "not detected" timepoint (and
no imputed value) at this sample.

When used, variants called only in the screening become new trajectories: their longitudinal samples are added as
above (not detected, with pileup counts). Their annotation is the ANNOVAR one of the screening; the other
trajectories keep the one of their Mutect2 calls.

```{r cross-grid}
if (use_cross) {
  traj_annot <- bind_rows(
    traj_annot_long,
    cross_calls %>%
      filter(!traj_id %in% traj_annot_long$traj_id) %>%
      select(ID, traj_id, all_of(annot_cols), var_type, rc_pos, rc_allele))

  cross_cols <- c("traj_id", "Sample", "LABDATE", "BORN", "LABYEAR", "Age", "AF", "DP", "GT", "AD", "F1R2", "F2R1",
                  "alt_reads", "n", "k", "k_star", "called", "lod_vaf", "vaf_reads", "lod_status")

  grid_all <- bind_rows(
    build_grid(traj_annot),
    cross_calls %>%
      select(all_of(cross_cols)) %>%
      left_join(traj_annot, by = "traj_id") %>%
      mutate(mutect = FALSE, type = "cross", source = "cross-sectional", detected = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(ID, traj_id, LABDATE)
} else {
  traj_annot <- traj_annot_long
  grid_all   <- grid_long
}
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(grid_all[c("traj_id", "Sample")]))

record_step(if (use_cross) "4. + cross-sectional calls" else "4. cross-sectional calls not used", grid_all)
```

`r if (use_cross) "Circle: Mutect2 call; square: cross-sectional call; cross: not detected (drawn at 0)." else "No plot: without the cross-sectional calls the trajectories are those of section 3."`

```{r plot-cross, eval = use_cross, fig.width=14, fig.height=11}
grid_all %>%
  mutate(AF_plot = ifelse(detected, AF, 0)) %>%
  plot_traj("source", shape_cross, "Mutect2 and cross-sectional calls, unfiltered")
```


# 5. Filter: VAF >= 2% and LoD

A trajectory is kept if at least one call (Mutect2 or cross-sectional) has a VAF >= 2% and at least
`min_tp_above_lod` = `r min_tp_above_lod` calls have a VAF >= LoD.

```{r filter-s5}
traj_s5_summary <- grid_all %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  group_by(ID, traj_id, Gene.refGene) %>%
  summarise(calls = n(), mutect_calls = sum(source == "Mutect2"), cross_calls = sum(source == "cross-sectional"),
            max_AF = max(AF), max_AF_mutect = suppressWarnings(max(AF[source == "Mutect2"])),
            calls_above_lod = sum(lod_status == "VAF >= LoD"), .groups = "drop")

# effect of the LoD requirement
map_dfr(1:2, function(m) {
  traj_s5_summary %>%
    summarise(`calls >= LoD required` = m,
              `max VAF >= 2%` = sum(max_AF >= chip_vaf),
              `max VAF >= 2% and enough calls >= LoD` = sum(max_AF >= chip_vaf & calls_above_lod >= m),
              individuals = n_distinct(ID[max_AF >= chip_vaf & calls_above_lod >= m]))
}) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Trajectories kept (of all trajectories)")

traj_s5_summary <- traj_s5_summary %>%
  mutate(reason = case_when(max_AF < chip_vaf                    ~ "removed: max VAF < 2%",
                            calls_above_lod < min_tp_above_lod   ~ "removed: too few calls >= LoD",
                            TRUE                                 ~ "kept"))

traj_s5_summary %>%
  group_by(reason) %>%
  summarise(trajectories = n(), individuals = n_distinct(ID), `calls, median` = median(calls),
            `max VAF %, median` = round(100 * median(max_AF), 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable()

traj_s5 <- traj_s5_summary$traj_id[traj_s5_summary$reason == "kept"]
grid_s5 <- grid_all %>% filter(traj_id %in% traj_s5)

record_step("5. >= 1 call with VAF >= 2% and >= min_tp_above_lod calls >= LoD", grid_s5)
```

Of the `r sum(grid_all$detected)` calls of either assay, `r sum(grid_all$detected & grid_all$lod_status != "VAF >= LoD")`
are below the LoD. Requiring two calls >= LoD (`min_tp_above_lod = 2`) removes the
`r sum(traj_s5_summary$max_AF >= chip_vaf & traj_s5_summary$calls_above_lod < 2)` trajectories with a single
call, before section 6 can add timepoints to them.

Trajectories whose only call >= 2% is the cross-sectional one (no Mutect2 call >= 2%). They pass this filter only
with `use_cross = TRUE`; `in the set` says whether they are kept here.

```{r filter-s5-cross}
calls %>%
  group_by(traj_id) %>%
  summarise(mutect_calls = n(), max_AF_mutect = max(AF), .groups = "drop") %>%
  right_join(cross_calls %>% select(ID, traj_id, Gene.refGene, AF_cross = AF), by = "traj_id") %>%
  filter(AF_cross >= chip_vaf, is.na(max_AF_mutect) | max_AF_mutect < chip_vaf) %>%
  arrange(ID) %>%
  transmute(ID, traj_id, Gene.refGene, mutect_calls = replace_na(mutect_calls, 0L),
            `max Mutect2 VAF %` = round(100 * max_AF_mutect, 2), `cross-sectional VAF %` = round(100 * AF_cross, 2),
            `in the set` = traj_id %in% traj_s5) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r plot-s5, fig.width=14, fig.height=11}
grid_s5 %>%
  mutate(AF_plot = ifelse(detected, AF, 0)) %>%
  plot_traj("source", shape_cross, "After section 5")
```


# 6. Timepoints added from bam-readcount

For the trajectories of section 5, the same variant (position and allele) is looked up in the pileup at the
longitudinal timepoints without a Mutect2 call. A timepoint is added when the pileup has at least
`min_alt_reads` = `r min_alt_reads` read of the variant allele: at the position of a clone the individual is known
to carry, any read of the allele is taken as the clone. Its VAF is the pileup read fraction. Calls are never
replaced.

At a depth of 2000, sequencing error alone gives on average `r round(2000 * err_rate / 3, 2)` reads of a given
base, so part of the timepoints with one or two reads can be error. The table shows where the added timepoints
stand against the LoD of their depth.

```{r bam-timepoints}
bam_obs <- grid_s5 %>%
  filter(source == "not detected") %>%
  mutate(pileup = case_when(is.na(n)                          ~ "no depth",
                            k == 0                            ~ "0 reads",
                            !called                           ~ "1 read to k* - 1 (not called)",
                            lod_status == "called, VAF < LoD" ~ ">= k*, VAF < LoD",
                            TRUE                              ~ "VAF >= LoD"),
         pileup = factor(pileup, levels = c("no depth", "0 reads", "1 read to k* - 1 (not called)",
                                            ">= k*, VAF < LoD", "VAF >= LoD")))

bam_obs %>%
  count(var_type, pileup) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pileup, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Longitudinal timepoints without a Mutect2 call, by reads of the variant allele in the pileup")
```

```{r bam-add}
grid_s6 <- grid_s5 %>%
  mutate(bam      = source == "not detected" & !is.na(k) & k >= min_alt_reads,
         source   = ifelse(bam, "bam-readcount", source),
         detected = source != "not detected",
         AF       = ifelse(bam, vaf_reads, AF)) %>%
  select(-bam)

grid_s6 %>%
  filter(source == "bam-readcount") %>%
  summarise(`timepoints added` = n(), trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id), individuals = n_distinct(ID),
            `reads, median (range)` = sprintf("%d (%d-%d)", as.integer(median(k)), min(k), max(k)),
            `VAF %, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(vaf_reads, 3, 100),
            `not called (k < k*)` = n_pct(lod_status == "not called (k < k*)"),
            `VAF >= LoD` = n_pct(lod_status == "VAF >= LoD")) %>%
  knitr::kable()

record_step(paste0("6. + bam-readcount timepoints (>= ", min_alt_reads, " read)"), grid_s6)
```

Circle: Mutect2 call; square: cross-sectional call (with `use_cross`); triangle: timepoint added from bam-readcount; cross: not
detected (drawn at 0).

```{r plot-s6, fig.width=14, fig.height=11}
grid_s6 %>%
  mutate(AF_plot = ifelse(detected, AF, 0)) %>%
  plot_traj("source", shape_source, "After section 6: calls and bam-readcount timepoints")
```


# 7. Filter: >= 2 detected timepoints

A trajectory is kept if it has at least `min_timepoints` = `r min_timepoints` detected timepoints (Mutect2,
cross-sectional or bam-readcount), at least one of them with VAF >= 2%. After section 5 every trajectory has a
call >= 2%, so the filter removes the trajectories seen at a single timepoint.

```{r filter-s7}
traj_s7_summary <- grid_s6 %>%
  group_by(ID, traj_id, Gene.refGene) %>%
  summarise(detected_timepoints = sum(detected), calls = sum(source %in% c("Mutect2", "cross-sectional")),
            max_AF = max(AF[detected]), no_pileup = sum(type == "long" & is.na(n)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(kept = detected_timepoints >= min_timepoints & max_AF >= chip_vaf)

traj_s7_summary %>%
  count(kept, name = "trajectories") %>%
  knitr::kable()

if (any(!traj_s7_summary$kept)) traj_s7_summary %>%
  filter(!kept) %>%
  arrange(ID) %>%
  transmute(ID, traj_id, Gene.refGene, detected_timepoints, calls, `max VAF %` = round(100 * max_AF, 2),
            `longitudinal timepoints without pileup depth` = no_pileup) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Trajectories removed")

traj_s7 <- traj_s7_summary$traj_id[traj_s7_summary$kept]
grid_s7 <- grid_s6 %>% filter(traj_id %in% traj_s7)

record_step("7. >= 2 detected timepoints, >= 1 with VAF >= 2%", grid_s7)
```

`r if (any(!traj_s7_summary$kept)) sprintf("%d of the %d removed trajectories have longitudinal timepoints without pileup depth: the pileup was not run at their position (a variant called only in the cross-sectional screening), so no timepoint could be added to them in section 6.", sum(!traj_s7_summary$kept & traj_s7_summary$no_pileup > 0), sum(!traj_s7_summary$kept)) else "No trajectory is removed."`


# 8. LoD and not detected timepoints

## 8.1 LoD at every timepoint

Each timepoint of a trajectory has a LoD from its depth: the call's depth (`DP`) at a Mutect2 or cross-sectional
call, the pileup depth at the variant otherwise. Mean and sd of the LoD over all timepoints of each trajectory
(timepoints without depth are left out):

```{r lod-traj}
lod_traj <- grid_s7 %>%
  group_by(ID, traj_id, Gene.refGene) %>%
  summarise(timepoints = n(), `timepoints with LoD` = sum(!is.na(lod_vaf)),
            lod_mean = mean(lod_vaf, na.rm = TRUE), lod_sd = sd(lod_vaf, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lod_cv = lod_sd / lod_mean)
stopifnot(all(lod_traj$`timepoints with LoD` >= 2))

lod_traj %>%
  summarise(trajectories = n(),
            `mean LoD %, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(lod_mean, 3, 100),
            `mean LoD %, range` = paste(round(100 * range(lod_mean), 3), collapse = "-"),
            `sd of LoD %, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(lod_sd, 3, 100),
            `sd of LoD %, max` = round(100 * max(lod_sd), 3),
            `CV (sd / mean), median (IQR)` = med_iqr(lod_cv, 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "LoD per trajectory")
```

```{r lod-traj-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
p_mean <- ggplot(lod_traj, aes(x = lod_mean)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "grey60", colour = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Mean LoD of the trajectory (VAF)", y = "Trajectories") +
  theme_classic()

p_range <- lod_traj %>%
  mutate(traj_id = fct_reorder(traj_id, lod_mean)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = traj_id, y = lod_mean, ymin = lod_mean - lod_sd, ymax = lod_mean + lod_sd, colour = Gene.refGene)) +
  geom_pointrange(size = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gene_colors) +
  labs(x = "Trajectories (ordered by mean LoD)", y = "LoD, mean +/- sd", colour = "CHIP gene") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

ggarrange(p_mean, p_range, ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 1.6), labels = c("A", "B"))
```

LoD across all timepoints of these trajectories, by type of timepoint (the cross-sectional screening, when used,
was sequenced less deeply and has a higher LoD):

```{r lod-all-timepoints}
lod_summary <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    summarise(timepoints = n(), `with LoD` = sum(!is.na(lod_vaf)),
              `depth, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(n),
              `LoD %, mean` = round(100 * mean(lod_vaf, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
              `LoD %, sd` = round(100 * sd(lod_vaf, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
              `LoD %, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(lod_vaf, 3, 100),
              `LoD %, range` = paste(round(100 * range(lod_vaf, na.rm = TRUE), 3), collapse = "-"),
              `LoD > 1%` = sum(lod_vaf > 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
              `LoD > 2%` = sum(lod_vaf > chip_vaf, na.rm = TRUE))
}

bind_rows(grid_s7 %>% group_by(timepoint = source) %>% lod_summary(),
          grid_s7 %>% lod_summary() %>% mutate(timepoint = "all")) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```


## 8.2 VAF of the not detected timepoints

A not detected timepoint says that the clone was below what the assay could see in this sample: its VAF is
somewhere between 0 and the LoD of the timepoint, which depends on the depth at the variant in this sample. It
gets `impute_fraction` = `r impute_fraction` times this LoD, the middle of that interval and the usual
substitution for values below a detection limit when the distribution is skewed towards 0 (Hornung & Reed, 1990),
as clone sizes before detection are. A timepoint without depth would get the same fraction of the mean LoD of its
trajectory.

Runs of consecutive not detected timepoints are then shortened: before the first detected timepoint of a
trajectory only the last not detected timepoint is kept, after the last detected timepoint only the first, i.e.
the one closest to a detected timepoint. It dates the appearance (or disappearance) of the clone; the earlier
(later) ones would add a flat stretch whose level is set by the depth, not by the clone. Not detected timepoints
between two detected ones are all kept.

```{r impute}
grid_s8 <- grid_s7 %>%
  left_join(lod_traj %>% select(traj_id, lod_mean, lod_sd), by = "traj_id") %>%
  mutate(imputed = !detected,
         AF      = ifelse(imputed, impute_fraction * coalesce(lod_vaf, lod_mean), AF),
         source  = ifelse(imputed, "imputed", source)) %>%
  arrange(traj_id, LABDATE, type) %>%
  group_by(traj_id) %>%
  mutate(position = case_when(detected                          ~ "detected",
                              cumsum(detected) == 0             ~ "before the first detected timepoint",
                              rev(cumsum(rev(detected))) == 0   ~ "after the last detected timepoint",
                              TRUE                              ~ "between two detected timepoints"),
         keep = detected | position == "between two detected timepoints" |
                (position == "before the first detected timepoint" & lead(detected, default = FALSE)) |
                (position == "after the last detected timepoint" & lag(detected, default = FALSE))) %>%
  ungroup()

c(`not detected timepoints without a LoD of their own` = sum(grid_s8$imputed & is.na(grid_s8$lod_vaf)))

grid_s8 %>%
  filter(imputed) %>%
  group_by(position) %>%
  summarise(`not detected timepoints` = n(), kept = sum(keep), removed = sum(!keep),
            trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id), `imputed VAF %, median (range)` =
              sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)", 100 * median(AF), 100 * min(AF), 100 * max(AF))) %>%
  knitr::kable()

my_chip_calls_imputed <- grid_s8 %>%
  filter(keep) %>%
  select(-position, -keep)

record_step("8. + not detected timepoints at LoD/2, runs shortened", my_chip_calls_imputed)
```

Bam-readcount timepoints with few reads can have a lower VAF than a not detected timepoint at the same depth:
`r sum(grid_s8$source == "bam-readcount" & grid_s8$AF < impute_fraction * grid_s8$lod_vaf)` of the
`r sum(grid_s8$source == "bam-readcount")` bam-readcount timepoints are below `impute_fraction` times the LoD of
their timepoint.

Final trajectories, log scale (on a linear scale the imputed values are indistinguishable from 0). Circle:
Mutect2 call; square: cross-sectional call (with `use_cross`); triangle: bam-readcount; open circle: imputed.

```{r plot-imputed, fig.width=14, fig.height=11}
my_chip_calls_imputed %>%
  mutate(AF_plot = AF) %>%
  plot_traj("source", shape_imputed, "Final trajectories, not detected timepoints at LoD / 2", y_log = TRUE)
```


## 8.3 Trajectory-specific LoD

One trajectory per panel (the trajectories of section 7). Black dotted line: LoD of each timepoint, from the depth
at the variant in that sample (section 8.1). Circle: Mutect2 call; square: cross-sectional call (with `use_cross`); triangle:
bam-readcount; open circle: imputed (half the LoD of the timepoint, the final trajectory of section 8.2); cross:
not detected timepoint removed when the runs were shortened (drawn at 0). The coloured line joins the timepoints
of the final trajectory. Dashed line: 2%. The y axis is pseudo-logarithmic, so that 0, the LoD and the CHIP
threshold show on the same scale.

```{r plot-traj-lod, fig.width=16, fig.height=22}
vaf_trans  <- pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 2e-4, base = 10)
vaf_breaks <- c(0, 0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3)
shape_lod  <- c(shape_imputed, "not detected" = 4)

# every timepoint of section 7; the ones removed in section 8.2 become crosses at 0
lod_panels <- grid_s8 %>%
  mutate(panel   = fct_reorder(paste(ID, Gene.refGene, sub(".*:", "", Variant)), ID),
         point   = ifelse(keep, source, "not detected"),
         AF_plot = ifelse(keep, AF, 0))

p_traj_lod <- ggplot(lod_panels, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = lod_vaf, linetype = "LoD of the timepoint"), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = filter(lod_panels, keep), aes(y = AF_plot, colour = Gene.refGene), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = AF_plot, colour = Gene.refGene, shape = point), size = 1.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = vaf_trans, breaks = vaf_breaks, labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gene_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_lod, limits = names(shape_lod)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("LoD of the timepoint" = "dotted")) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 8, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "VAF", colour = "CHIP gene", shape = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7), legend.position = "bottom")

p_traj_lod
```


## 8.4 Trajectory-specific LoD with the cross-sectional calls

The plot of section 8.3, with the calls of the cross-sectional screening (section 4) added as squares and the LoD of
the cross-sectional sample added to the black dotted line. The calls are only drawn here and are not part of the
trajectories: the panels and the coloured line are those of section 8.3. With `use_cross = TRUE` the two plots are
the same.

```{r plot-traj-lod-cross, fig.width=16, fig.height=22}
shape_lod_cross <- c("Mutect2" = 16, "cross-sectional" = 15, "bam-readcount" = 17, "imputed" = 1, "not detected" = 4)

# cross-sectional calls of the trajectories of section 8.3 that are not already in its plot
cross_points <- cross_calls %>%
  anti_join(lod_panels, by = c("traj_id", "Sample")) %>%
  select(traj_id, Age, AF_plot = AF, lod_vaf) %>%
  inner_join(lod_panels %>% distinct(traj_id, panel, Gene.refGene), by = "traj_id") %>%
  mutate(point = "cross-sectional")

# the layers of section 8.3 on data with these timepoints added: the dotted line and the points use them, the
# coloured line keeps its own data
p_traj_lod %+%
  bind_rows(lod_panels, cross_points) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_lod_cross, limits = names(shape_lod_cross))
```

The screening was sequenced less deeply, so the dotted line rises at the cross-sectional sample (median LoD
`r percent(median(cross_calls$lod_vaf), 0.01)`). `r nrow(semi_join(cross_calls, lod_panels, by = "traj_id"))` of the
`r nrow(cross_calls)` cross-sectional calls are in this plot. The others belong to trajectories without a panel:

```{r cross-not-in-plot}
cross_calls %>%
  anti_join(lod_panels, by = "traj_id") %>%
  arrange(ID) %>%
  transmute(ID, traj_id, `Mutect2 calls` = map_int(traj_id, ~ sum(calls$traj_id == .x)),
            `cross-sectional VAF %` = round(100 * AF, 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```


# 9. Counts after each step

`samples (timepoints)`: longitudinal samples of the individuals left (each is a timepoint of every trajectory of
its individual), plus, with `use_cross`, their cross-sectional samples from section 4 on. `detected timepoints` and
`not detected timepoints` are trajectory x sample combinations; in the final table the not detected ones carry
the imputed VAF.

```{r step-counts}
knitr::kable(step_counts)
```


# 10. Final table

One row per trajectory and timepoint. Columns:

- `ID`, demographics (`BORN` to `CV_SMOKED`), `traj_id`, `LABDATE`, `N_CHIP` (trajectories of the individual).
- Annotation (`AAChange.refGene` to `cosmic70`, `Variant`), the same at every row of a trajectory: from its
  Mutect2 calls (VCF coordinates) or, for a variant called only in the cross-sectional screening, from that call
  (ANNOVAR coordinates).
- Measurement: `GT`, `AD`, `AF`, `DP`, `F1R2`, `F2R1`. `AD` and `DP` of a bam-readcount timepoint are the pileup
  counts; an imputed timepoint has only `AF`.
- `type`: `long` (longitudinal sequencing) or `cross` (cross-sectional screening, only with `use_cross`).
  `source`: `original` (a call),
  `bam_readcount` or `imputed`.
- `LABYEAR`, `Age`, `Sample`.
- `lod_depth` and `lod_alt_reads` (read counts behind the LoD: the call's at a call, the pileup's otherwise),
  `lod_vaf`, `lod_status`, and `traj_lod_mean`, `traj_lod_sd` (section 8.1).

```{r final-table}
my_chip_calls_filtered2 <- my_chip_calls_imputed %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(N_CHIP = n_distinct(traj_id)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(pat %>% select(-BORN), by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(AD      = ifelse(source == "bam-readcount", paste(n - k, k, sep = ","), AD),
         DP      = ifelse(source == "bam-readcount", n, DP),
         source  = case_when(source %in% c("Mutect2", "cross-sectional") ~ "original",
                             source == "bam-readcount"                   ~ "bam_readcount",
                             TRUE                                        ~ source),
         LABDATE = as.character(LABDATE)) %>%
  transmute(ID, BORN, SEX, GENETIC_SEX, ETHNICITY, HIV_POSDATE, IVD, RISK, CV_SMOKED, traj_id, LABDATE, N_CHIP,
            AAChange.refGene, Gene.refGene, Chr, Start, End, Ref, Alt, Func.refGene, GeneDetail.refGene,
            ExonicFunc.refGene, cosmic70, GT, AD, AF, DP, F1R2, F2R1, Variant, type, source, LABYEAR, Age,
            Sample, lod_depth = n, lod_alt_reads = k, lod_vaf, lod_status = as.character(lod_status),
            traj_lod_mean = lod_mean, traj_lod_sd = lod_sd) %>%
  arrange(ID, traj_id, LABDATE)
stopifnot(!anyNA(my_chip_calls_filtered2$AF), !anyNA(my_chip_calls_filtered2$Age))

table(type = my_chip_calls_filtered2$type, source = my_chip_calls_filtered2$source)
```

```{r save-final}
write.table(my_chip_calls_filtered2, "resources/chip_calls_long_filtered.txt", sep="\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

Two intermediate tables that the paper does not use (`chip_calls_long_not_filtered.txt`,
`chip_calls_long_rerun.txt`): all Mutect2 calls kept in
section 1, in the columns of `chip_calls.csv` with the annotation of the called allele (section 1.2; the transcript
columns `Accession`, `transcriptOI`, `NonsynOI` belong to the annotation in the file and are left out), and the
trajectories of section 5 (Mutect2 calls, cross-sectional calls with `use_cross`, not detected timepoints at
`AF = 0`).

```{r save-intermediate}
chip_calls_long_not_filtered <- chip_calls_file %>%
  filter(X %in% calls$X) %>%
  select(-Accession, -transcriptOI, -NonsynOI) %>%
  rows_update(calls %>%
                distinct(X) %>%
                left_join(annot_check %>% select(X, all_of(paste0(dict_cols, "_allele"))), by = "X") %>%
                rename_with(~ sub("_allele$", "", .x), -X),
              by = "X") %>%
  inner_join(calls %>% distinct(Sample, ID, LABDATE), by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(LABDATE = as.character(LABDATE)) %>%
  select(-Sample)
stopifnot(nrow(chip_calls_long_not_filtered) == nrow(calls))

chip_calls_long_rerun <- grid_s5 %>%
  transmute(ID, LABDATE = as.character(LABDATE), Gene.refGene, Chr, Start, End, Ref, Alt, Func.refGene,
            GeneDetail.refGene, ExonicFunc.refGene, AAChange.refGene, cosmic70, GT, AD,
            AF = ifelse(detected, AF, 0), DP, F1R2, F2R1, type, Variant, traj_id)

write.table(chip_calls_long_not_filtered, "resources/chip_calls_long_not_filtered.txt", quote = F, row.names = F, sep="\t")
write.table(chip_calls_long_rerun, "resources/chip_calls_long_rerun.txt", quote = F, sep="\t")
```

## 11.2 Distribution of the CHIP variants

One row per trajectory. The y axis of the bar plots runs to 30, or further if a count is larger.

```{r variants}
mut_levels <- c("splicing", "frameshift insertion", "frameshift deletion", "stopgain", "nonsynonymous SNV")

traj_variants <- my_chip_calls_filtered2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(ExonicFunc.refGene)) %>%
  select(ID, Gene.refGene, traj_id, ExonicFunc.refGene) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(Gene.refGene=ifelse(Gene.refGene %in% c("GNAS", "JAK2", "SF3B1", "SRSF2", "KRAS"), "Other", Gene.refGene)) %>%
  mutate(Gene.refGene=factor(Gene.refGene, levels = c("DNMT3A", "TET2", "ASXL1", "TP53", "PPM1D", "Other")))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(traj_variants$traj_id), all(traj_variants$ExonicFunc.refGene %in% mut_levels))

traj_variants %>%
  group_by(Gene.refGene) %>%
  summarise(N=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Prop=N/sum(N))

traj_variants %>%
  mutate(ExonicFunc.refGene=factor(ExonicFunc.refGene, levels = mut_levels)) %>%
  group_by(ExonicFunc.refGene) %>%
  summarise(N=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Prop=N/sum(N)) %>%
  arrange(-N)
```

```{r n-chip-plot, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
ggsave("figures/num_chip.png", plot = num_chip, dpi=300, width = 5, height = 4)
```


## 11.4 Depth and LoD of every CHIP measurement

One row per trajectory and timepoint of the final set, with the new ID of the individual (`SHCS_change_ids.txt`)
in place of the SHCS ID, also in the trajectory name. Columns:

- `SHCS_ID`, `Trajectory`, `Gene`, `Variant` (transcript of interest), `Chr`, `Position`, `Ref`, `Alt` (the
  variant in VCF coordinates, so that it can be found without the annotation; ANNOVAR coordinates for a variant
  called only in the cross-sectional screening), `Age`.
- `Source`: Mutect2 call, bam-readcount timepoint, imputed (not detected, VAF = half the LoD of the timepoint) or,
  with `use_cross`, cross-sectional call. Imputed rows are kept because they are part of the trajectories that are
  analysed; filter on `Source` to drop them.
- `Depth`, `Alt_reads`: the read counts behind the LoD (Mutect2's at a call, the pileup's otherwise).
- `VAF`: the VAF of the trajectory (Mutect2's `AF` at a Mutect2 call, `Alt_reads / Depth` at a bam-readcount
  timepoint, the imputed value otherwise).
- `LoD`, and `Above_LoD` (`Alt_reads / Depth` >= LoD; empty for imputed rows), which says which measured values
  are reliable at their depth.

The sample barcode and the collection date are left out: `Age` places the timepoint, and the date would identify
the participant.

```{r variant-table}
variant_table <- my_chip_calls_filtered2 %>%
  left_join(new_ids, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(id_number = as.integer(sub("SHCS_", "", SHCS_ID_new))) %>%
  arrange(id_number, traj_id, LABDATE, type) %>%
  transmute(SHCS_ID    = as.character(SHCS_ID_new),
            Trajectory = paste(SHCS_ID, Variant, sep = ":"),
            Gene       = Gene.refGene,
            Variant, Chr, Position = Start, Ref, Alt, Age,
            Source     = measurement,
            Depth      = lod_depth,
            Alt_reads  = lod_alt_reads,
            VAF        = round(AF, 5),
            LoD        = round(lod_vaf, 5),
            Above_LoD  = ifelse(measurement == "imputed", NA, lod_status == "VAF >= LoD"))
stopifnot(nrow(variant_table) == nrow(my_chip_calls_filtered2), !anyNA(variant_table$SHCS_ID),
          !anyNA(variant_table$Depth), !anyNA(variant_table$LoD))

table(Source = variant_table$Source, Above_LoD = variant_table$Above_LoD, useNA = "ifany")

head(variant_table, 15) %>% knitr::kable(caption = "First rows")

write.table(variant_table, "results/SHCS_CHIP_variants_depth_LoD.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
write.table(variant_table, file.path(paper_dir, "Tables", "SHCS_CHIP_variants_depth_LoD.txt"),
            sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```


## 11.5 Summary of the final trajectories

Follow-up is the time from the first to the last timepoint (collection dates) of an individual or a trajectory.
Measurements are the rows of the table of section 11.4.

```{r trajectory-summary}
fmt_dist <- function(x, digits = 0, scale = 1) {
  x <- x * scale
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.5, 0.25, 0.75))
  sprintf("%.*f (IQR %.*f-%.*f; range %.*f-%.*f)", digits, q[1], digits, q[2], digits, q[3],
          digits, min(x), digits, max(x))
}
n_of <- function(x, total) sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", x, 100 * x / total)

final_set <- my_chip_calls_filtered2 %>%
  mutate(LABDATE = as.Date(LABDATE), detected = measurement != "imputed")

per_traj <- final_set %>%
  group_by(ID, traj_id) %>%
  summarise(timepoints = n(), n_detected = sum(detected), max_vaf = max(AF[detected]),
            followup = as.numeric(max(LABDATE) - min(LABDATE)) / 365.25, .groups = "drop")
stopifnot(all(per_traj$max_vaf >= chip_vaf))

per_ind <- final_set %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id), samples = n_distinct(Sample),
            followup = as.numeric(max(LABDATE) - min(LABDATE)) / 365.25, age_first = min(Age), .groups = "drop")

n_traj <- nrow(per_traj)
n_meas <- nrow(final_set)
detected_meas <- final_set %>% filter(detected)

traj_counts <- table(per_ind$trajectories)

trajectory_summary <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Group = "Individuals",
         Characteristic = c("Individuals", "Trajectories per individual"),
         Value = c(nrow(per_ind), fmt_dist(per_ind$trajectories))),
  tibble(Group = "Individuals",
         Characteristic = paste("Individuals with", names(traj_counts),
                                ifelse(names(traj_counts) == "1", "trajectory", "trajectories")),
         Value = n_of(as.integer(traj_counts), nrow(per_ind))),
  tibble(Group = "Individuals",
         Characteristic = c("Samples (timepoints)", "Samples per individual", "Follow-up per individual, years",
                            "Age at the first sample, years"),
         Value = c(n_distinct(final_set$Sample), fmt_dist(per_ind$samples), fmt_dist(per_ind$followup, 1),
                   fmt_dist(per_ind$age_first))),
  tibble(Group = "Trajectories",
         Characteristic = c("Trajectories", "Timepoints per trajectory", "Detected timepoints per trajectory",
                            "Follow-up per trajectory, years", "Maximum VAF per trajectory, %",
                            "Trajectories with maximum VAF >= 10%"),
         Value = c(n_traj, fmt_dist(per_traj$timepoints), fmt_dist(per_traj$n_detected),
                   fmt_dist(per_traj$followup, 1), fmt_dist(per_traj$max_vaf, 1, 100),
                   n_of(sum(per_traj$max_vaf >= 0.1), n_traj))),
  final_set %>%
    count(measurement, .drop = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(Group = "Measurements", Characteristic = paste("Measurements:", measurement), Value = n_of(n, n_meas)),
  tibble(Group = "Measurements",
         Characteristic = c("Measurements", "Depth at the variant", "LoD, %",
                            "Detected measurements with VAF >= LoD"),
         Value = c(n_meas, fmt_dist(final_set$lod_depth), fmt_dist(final_set$lod_vaf, 2, 100),
                   n_of(sum(detected_meas$lod_status == "VAF >= LoD"), nrow(detected_meas)))),
  traj_variants %>%
    count(Gene.refGene) %>%
    transmute(Group = "Trajectories by gene", Characteristic = as.character(Gene.refGene), Value = n_of(n, n_traj)),
  traj_variants %>%
    count(ExonicFunc.refGene, sort = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(Group = "Trajectories by mutation type", Characteristic = ExonicFunc.refGene, Value = n_of(n, n_traj)))
stopifnot(sum(traj_variants$Gene.refGene %in% levels(traj_variants$Gene.refGene)) == n_traj)

knitr::kable(trajectory_summary)

write.table(trajectory_summary, "results/SHCS_CHIP_trajectories_summary.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
write.table(trajectory_summary, file.path(paper_dir, "Tables", "SHCS_CHIP_trajectories_summary.txt"),
            sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```


## 11.6 Depth and LoD of CHIP and non-CHIP variants

- **CHIP**: every longitudinal measurement of the final set (section 11.4): Mutect2 calls, bam-readcount and
  imputed timepoints. The depth is Mutect2's at a call and the pileup's otherwise (they differ by about 2%,
  section 1.3).
- **non-CHIP**: every Mutect2 call in the same samples that is more than 1 bp away from all listed CHIP variants
  (section 1.2), without the calls Mutect2 flags as `germline` or `multiallelic` and without chrY (the definition
  of `01_per_sample_LoD_and_QC.Rmd`). Depth is Mutect2's `DP`.

The LoD is calculated from the depth in the same way for both. It depends on depth only, so the comparison is one
of sequencing depth at the two kinds of sites.

```{r nonchip-calls}
# DP and the alternate reads of AD of every record of a single-sample Mutect2 VCF; FORMAT differs between
# records (phased ones carry PGT:PID:PS), so the fields are looked up by name
read_mutect2_records <- function(sample) {
  vcf <- read.table(gzfile(file.path("resources/mutect2_Calls/mutect2_output", paste0(sample, ".vcf.gz"))),
                    sep = "\t", colClasses = c(V1 = "character", V4 = "character", V5 = "character",
                                               V7 = "character", V9 = "character", V10 = "character"))
  fmt <- strsplit(vcf$V9, ":", fixed = TRUE)
  val <- strsplit(vcf$V10, ":", fixed = TRUE)
  field <- function(name) mapply(function(f, v) v[match(name, f)], fmt, val)
  tibble(Sample = sample, CHROM = vcf$V1, POS = vcf$V2, FILTER = vcf$V7, AD = field("AD"),
         DP = as.integer(field("DP")))
}

final_samples <- unique(my_chip_calls_filtered2$Sample[my_chip_calls_filtered2$type == "long"])
chip_window   <- unique(paste(annot_dict$Chr, c(annot_dict$Start - 1, annot_dict$Start, annot_dict$Start + 1)))

nonchip_calls <- map_dfr(final_samples, read_mutect2_records) %>%
  filter(!grepl("germline|multiallelic", FILTER), CHROM != "chrY", !paste(CHROM, POS) %in% chip_window) %>%
  mutate(n = DP, k = as.integer(str_split_fixed(AD, ",", 3)[, 2])) %>%
  filter(n > 0, k <= n) %>%
  add_lod()

# at a very low depth no VAF up to 0.5 reaches the target power, and the package returns no LoD
c(non_CHIP_calls = nrow(nonchip_calls), samples = n_distinct(nonchip_calls$Sample),
  without_LoD = sum(is.na(nonchip_calls$lod_vaf)))
```

```{r depth-lod-summary}
chip_colors <- c("CHIP" = "#00BFC4", "non-CHIP" = "#F8766D")

depth_lod <- bind_rows(
  my_chip_calls_filtered2 %>% filter(type == "long") %>% transmute(group = "CHIP", depth = lod_depth, lod = lod_vaf),
  nonchip_calls %>% transmute(group = "non-CHIP", depth = n, lod = lod_vaf)) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = names(chip_colors)))

depth_lod %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(observations = n(),
            `depth, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(depth),
            `depth, range` = paste(range(depth), collapse = "-"),
            `LoD %, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(lod, 3, 100),
            `LoD %, range` = paste(round(100 * range(lod, na.rm = TRUE), 3), collapse = "-"),
            `LoD > 1%` = sum(lod > 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
            `no LoD (depth too low)` = sum(is.na(lod))) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r depth-lod-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
group_labels <- depth_lod %>%
  count(group) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(group, "\n(n = ", n, ")"))
group_labels <- setNames(group_labels$label, group_labels$group)

p_depth <- ggplot(depth_lod, aes(x = group, y = depth, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, colour = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.4) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = group_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = chip_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Depth at the variant") +
  theme_classic()

p_lod <- ggplot(depth_lod %>% filter(!is.na(lod)), aes(x = group, y = lod, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, colour = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.4) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = percent) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = group_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = chip_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Limit of detection (VAF)") +
  theme_classic()

pl <- ggarrange(p_depth, p_lod, ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"))
pl

ggsave("figures/SHCS_CHIP_nonCHIP_depth_LoD.png", plot = pl, dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 4)
```
